div.div:
TRANSACTION RELATIONSHIP PRINCIPLE
Transactions are distinct financial activity records.
Each transaction is associated with an Ananse customer and an Ananse wallet.
Customer and wallet remain distinct entities; no direct Customer → Wallet relationship is asserted.
